subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should Control UI reply targets become a typed chat.send/Gateway current-turn inbound metadata contract now, or remain Markdown quote-only until the broader reply-context work lands?
rationale: Current main has the UI affordance and runtime carrier infrastructure, but choosing the permanent public Gateway/session contract and its relationship to #90745/#88032/#87561 is an owner/product boundary decision.

options.title: Define typed reply metadata now
options.body: Add a structured Control UI/Gateway reply-to payload and route it through the runtime-context carrier while coordinating with #90745 and #88032.

options.title: Keep Markdown-only for now
options.body: Treat #92654 as the supported Control UI behavior and narrow this issue to the remaining fallback semantics tracked by #87561.

options.title: Split canonical ownership
options.body: Move reply metadata to #88032/#90745 and final fallback semantics to #87561, then close this mixed issue after both links are explicit.

recommendation.title: Define typed reply metadata now
recommendation.body: Add a structured Control UI/Gateway reply-to payload and route it through the runtime-context carrier while coordinating with #90745 and #88032.

likelyOwner.reason: Marvinthebored owns the most relevant merged runtime-context carrier work and can judge how a typed reply payload should enter that path.
